items.question: Can either party assign the MSA?
items.answer:
The Harrowgate MSA does not explicitly state that either party can assign the agreement. Instead, it states that neither party may assign the Agreement without the prior written consent of the other party, such consent not to be unreasonably withheld [1].

Additionally, the Harrowgate MSA includes a provision regarding Change of Control, requiring Provider to provide no less than thirty (30) days' prior written notice of any Change of Control to Client, and allowing Client to terminate the Agreement for cause if such notice is not given [1][1].

There is no mention of assignment in other clauses of the Harrowgate MSA. The other sources referenced, such as the Unit 7 Lease, Northbridge NDA, and Kestrel Storage Services Agreement, are not directly related to the Harrowgate MSA and do not provide terms about assignment of the Harrowgate MSA.

evidence.quote: Neither party may assign this Agreement without the prior written consent of the other party, such consent not to be unreasonably withheld.
Provider shall provide no less than thirty (30) days' prior written notice of any Change of Control to Client in accordance with Clause 22.
If Provider fails to give notice under Clause 14.2, Client may terminate this Agreement for cause by written notice within ninety (90) days of becoming aware of the Change of Control.

items.question: Does the Calder & Wynne engagement include tax advice?
items.answer:
The Calder & Wynne engagement letter states that the scope of work includes advising Voss-Lindqvist AB on the renewal of its Master Services Agreement with Harrowgate Systems Inc. and reviewing its mutual non-disclosure agreement with Northbridge Analytics Ltd. [1]

The engagement letter also states that the work does not include tax advice or advice on the laws of any jurisdiction other than England and Wales. [1]
